description: Ranks tweets by technical depth across three dimensions: concrete specificity (specific algorithms/frameworks vs. generic terms), demonstrated expertise (understanding of trade-offs and limitations), and practical applicability (actionable insights for practitioners). Elevates substantive technical discourse over AI hype.

items.description: A tweet with text, images, and videos

text.description: The text content of the post

messages.$starlark: [{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Which of these tweets demonstrates the most specific technical knowledge about particular algorithms, frameworks, methodologies, or established technologies?'}]}]

responses.$starlark: [[{'type': 'text', 'text': t['text']}] + t['images'] + t['videos'] for t in input['items']]

messages.$starlark: [{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Which tweet best demonstrates genuine technical expertise through discussion of trade-offs, limitations, complexity, or awareness of current research directions?'}]}]

responses.$starlark: [[{'type': 'text', 'text': t['text']}] + t['images'] + t['videos'] for t in input['items']]

messages.$starlark: [{'role': 'user', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Which tweet would be most valuable to a practitioner or researcher looking for actionable insights and concrete approaches to technical problems?'}]}]

responses.$starlark: [[{'type': 'text', 'text': t['text']}] + t['images'] + t['videos'] for t in input['items']]
